mechanics.name: Aqua Charges
mechanics.body: Aqua Charges are and optional mechanic gained during Short and Long Rests, and some during the start of combat to empower your Water spells in various ways.

mechanics.name: Immobilize
mechanics.body: Immobilized creatures **cannot move** and fail any **AGI** rolls. You can still Teleport while immobilized. Immobilize is a Weak Debuff.

mechanics.name: Disarm
mechanics.body: Disarmed creatures cannot make Attack actions, although they can still cast spells but do not gain the benefit of a spell Foci or items equipped in their hands. Disarm is a Weak Debuff.

spells.name: Aqua Charges
spells.body: You have a maximum of **Aqua Charges** equal to **4**, which increases by **+1** per 4 Player Levels, and **+1** per 12 Water CA. During Short and Long Rests your Aqua Charges reset to full. At the start of Combat gain **+3 Aqua Charges** up to your maximum. Charges gained this way increases by **+1** per 24 Water CA.

upgrades.text: At the end of your turn gain **+1** Mana per **3 Aqua Charges** consumed since the end of your last turn.
At the start of your turn gain **+1** Aqua Charge, which increases by **+1** per 36 Water CA.

spells.name: Bubble
spells.body:
As a **Full Action** conjure a large sphere of water entirely engulfing a creature **Medium** or smaller. If the creature fails an **AGI** save, they become **Immobilized** for up to *10 turns* or until you lose **Concentration**. Creatures immobilized this way have Disadvantage on **AGI** saves and Disadvantage on all Martial and Spell Attack rolls. A creature may use a **Half Action** to attempt escaping the bubble using a **STR** save.

As an **Extra Action** or **Half Action**, you can consume **2 Aqua Charges** to flood their lungs with water, dealing **2d8** Cold damage. Damage increases by **+1d8** per 12 Water CA.

upgrades.text: Bubble can now be used on Large or Huge creatures, however the bubble forms around their head and it cannot Immobilizes them (you can still drown them).
Bubble becomes a Minor Concentration spell.

spells.name: Enchant Weapon: Water
spells.body:
As a *Half Action* enchant your weapon for your next **3** attacks/spell casts. Gain the following effects while enchanted depending on the weapon type:

**Melee**: Full Attacks gain bonus **+1d8** Flat Cold damage on hit, while Half Attacks gain **+1d4**. Damage Dice Count increases by **+1** per 18 Water CA and every 4 Player Levels.

**Ranged**: Full Attacks gain bonus **+1d6** Flat Cold damage on hit, while Half Attacks gain **+1d4**. Damage Dice Count increases by **+1** per 18 Water CA and every 3 Player Levels.

**Spell Focus**: Enchanted spells gain **+3m** to range, **+1m** to length, width and radius, and **+2m** to diameter. Enchanted spell attacks have **Advantage** to enemies affected by immobilize or disarm, or enemies that have 2 Minor Debuffs.

upgrades.text: Spend **2 Aqua Charges** when making Enchanted Full Attacks to add bonus **+1d8** Flat Aether damage. Spend **1 Charge** per Enchanted Half Attacks to increase the Dice Tier of bonus damage gained by **+1**. Charges can be spent multiple times this way to empower the attacks further.

Spend **4 Aqua Charges** when casting this spell to add bonus **+1d6** Flat Aether damage to Enchanted Full Attacks, and **+1d4** to Enchanted Half Attacks. Damage Dice Count increases by **+1** per 12 Water CA.
Defeating an enemy with an Enchanted spell or attack grants you **2 Mana**, up to 8 Mana per Action. *+1 Mana Cost*.
Consume **5 Aqua Charges** to increase the damage Dice Tier for enchanted spells cast.

spells.name: Aquatic Lash
spells.body:
As a **Full Action** make a Melee Spell Attack against an enemy within 6m whipping them with a torrent of water, dealing **1d6** Cold damage and **1d6** Aether damage on it. Both damages types increase by **+1d6** per 12 Water CA.

If the spell hits, you can consume **1-4 Aqua Charges** to move the creature in any cardinal direction, **2m** per Charge consumed.

upgrades.text: If you **defeat** and enemy with this spell, drain their body of water gaining **Aqua Charges** depending on their **Size Dice Tier**. 1 for Tiny, 2 for Small or Medium, 4 for Large and 6 for Huge, and 12 for Gigantic.
If the attack hits, the creature must make a DEX save or become Disarmed for 1 turn.

spells.name: Rejuvenating Spring
spells.body:
As a **Full Action** target yourself or an ally, giving them a sip of healing water. The target gains **+1d8** Health. The healing Dice Tier *Dice Tier* increases by +1 per 24 Water CA.

You may consume any number of **Aqua Charges** to increase the healing Dice Tier *Count* by +1 per 2 Charges consumed this way.

upgrades.text: You may cast this spell as a **Half Action** if you also consume **1 Aqua Charge**. *-1 Mana Cost*.

When this spell is cast on an ally and not yourself, the target gains **2 Mana**, and an additional **+2** Mana per **2 Aqua Charges** consumed (*this Upgrade doesn’t let you consume Aqua Charges, it looks at how many total were consumed with spell from other means*).

signatureSpells.name: Aquatic Shield
signatureSpells.body: As a **Full Action**, target yourself or an ally within **6m** enshrouding them in a protective bubble. Aquatic Shield is a Weak Buff that lasts for 3 rounds, increasing by **+1** round per 18 Water CA. Creatures with Aquatic Shield become **Resistant** to Non-Magical damage, as well as Aether, Cold and Fire damage. Aquatic Shield is removed after the creature takes a certain number of hits or instances of damage. Damage from Weak Debuffs **does not** count towards this limit. The number of hits/damage is **3**, gaining **+1** per 18 Water CA and at Warden Levels 3, 6 and 9.

upgrades.text: Spend Aqua Charges to increase the amount of hits Aquatic Shield can protect from. For every **1 Charge** consumed, increases the number of hits by **+1**.
When any creature within **15m** has their Aquatic Shield removed by damage, gain **3 Mana**. Mana gained this way increases by **+1** at Warden Levels 6 and 10.
